claims: The University of Denver (DU) Pioneers won their 11th NCAA national championship.
The University of Denver (DU) Pioneers defeated Wisconsin 2-1 on April 11, 2026, in Las Vegas.
The University of Denver (DU) Pioneers defeated Michigan 4-3 in double-overtime in the semifinal.
Johnny Hicks made 49 saves in the semifinal.
Johnny Hicks made 29 saves in the final.
The championship win brought the Pioneers to a 28-11-3 record to end the season.
Replays of the championship tournament are available through ESPN/ESPN+.
